name: Back to Billy
summary: Bernice Stonefield sends you across the road with a pork belly pie for Billy Maclure. He has information about her missing necklace, and the delivery carries on the feud between their families in central Elwynn Forest.

sections.title: A Bitter Pie
sections.body: The feud between the Stonefields and Maclures leaves little room for kindness. Auntie Bernice Stonefield baked a pork belly pie because Billy Maclure would not share what he knew about her family heirloom without one. She hands you the pie with plain irritation. Bernice hopes Billy chokes on every bite.

sections.title: A Boy's Bribe
sections.body: At the Maclure Vineyards, across the road, Billy Maclure waits hungry and cannot remember what happened to the necklace. The rivalry between the two homesteads reaches their children too. They barter gossip and stolen trinkets for farm treats. With the pie delivered, Billy remembers, and the search for the necklace's true location can begin.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this delivery?
faq.answer: Billy Maclure says he knows where Auntie Bernice Stonefield's lost necklace is, but he will not talk until you bring him a home-cooked pork belly pie. The delivery meets his demand, so he will reveal where the heirloom went.

faq.q: Why is Auntie Bernice so upset with Billy?
faq.answer: The Stonefield and Maclure families have been locked in a bitter rural feud for years. Bernice resents cooking a treat for a troublesome Maclure child to recover an heirloom that went missing on their borders.

faq.q: Where does Billy say the necklace actually is?
faq.answer: After eating the pie, Billy reveals that he did not keep the necklace. Goldtooth, a notorious kobold in the Fargodeep Mine, got it.
Billy Maclure is at the Maclure Vineyards, just south of the road in central Elwynn Forest and opposite the Stonefield Farm.

faq.q: Who baked the Pork Belly Pie?
faq.answer: Auntie Bernice Stonefield baked the pie at the Stonefield Farm after you gathered fresh chunks of boar meat from the nearby wilderness.

faq.q: Does this quest resolve the feud between the families?
faq.answer: No. The pie satisfies Billy's personal bribe, while the deep animosity between the adult Stonefields and Maclures remains.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you find disputes between human farmsteads even in peaceful Elwynn Forest. Helping local folk often means dealing with these quarrels.
As a cook, you know pork belly pie as a comforting Elwynn farmhouse dish made from meat of the forest's roaming wild boars.
